decisions.reason: The $12 change applies only to no-code commissions. The coded-referral $35 decision is independent and is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that updates the no-code FAQ explanation to a $12 commission; no additional or corrected fields are required.
Changing the no-referral commission amount does not alter coded-referral ticket issuance. The separately accepted four-ticket rule is already represented.
The source commission change does not alter no-referral ticket quantity or allocation. The accepted six-ticket rule is already captured separately at the same message.
The no-referral commission amount does not change the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral identity or its display locations.
The landing-page $10 commission copy describes coded affiliate referrals; the source changes only the randomly allocated no-code commission.
The accepted $12 no-code commission does not change which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The no-referral commission amount does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility, or pool allocation.

The candidate already requires randomly distributed commissions to appear in NFT attributes, while the source changes only the underlying commission amount. The same message's stale-attribute observation is already represented as a runtime failure.

The candidate's $10 affiliate allocation concerns coded affiliate mints. The source changes the separate commission awarded by draw when no referral code is used and does not explicitly revise the mint revenue split.
The no-referral commission amount does not affect which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.

The reporting requirement remains to display the underlying commission and ticket accounting accurately. The source amount change requires no separate value-state update here, and its same-message reporting result is already represented as runtime verification.
